description: A vasculitic disorder that can produce urticaria-like lesions.

appearance.general: Urticarial lesions may be painful or burning and can persist longer than ordinary urticaria.

warning_signs: Persistent painful or burning urticarial lesions, bruising, or systemic symptoms warrant medical evaluation.
